prompt.en: The reef repeats itself. To open the gate, put back what the storm tore out.
prompt.ar: الشِّعَابُ تُكَرِّرُ نَفْسَهَا. لِتَفْتَحَ البَوَّابَة، أَعِدْ مَا اقْتَلَعَتْهُ العَاصِفَة.

hint1.en: Say the ledge out loud from the start. What comes after that?
hint1.ar: اُنْطُقِ الحَافَةَ بِصَوْتٍ عَالٍ مِنَ البِدَايَة. مَاذَا يَأْتِي بَعْدَ ذَلِك؟

hint2.en: Look at the same place one repeat earlier.
hint2.ar: اُنْظُرْ إِلَى المَكَانِ نَفْسِهِ فِي التَّكْرَارِ السَّابِق.

model.en: This one belongs here. Look why, then put it back yourself.
model.ar: هَذِهِ مَكَانُهَا هُنَا. اُنْظُرْ لِمَاذَا، ثُمَّ أَعِدْهَا بِنَفْسِك.

success.en: You read the whole current. The gate is open and Sadaf is through.
success.ar: قَرَأْتَ التَّيَّارَ كُلَّه. اِنْفَتَحَتِ البَوَّابَةُ وَعَبَرَتْ صَدَف.

payload._comment: The climax, and the only thing in the chapter that asks the child to work out a RULE and then use it somewhere they cannot see the answer. Sadaf cannot do this — she says so — which is what makes the child, not the turtle, the one who opens the way. Three rounds, and the unit gets harder each time: AB, then AAB, then ABC. Difficulty comes from the pattern, never from a tier.
payload._notSortingComment: Sorting asks which box a thing belongs in, and its verdict for an item is the same wherever it lands. This asks what is missing from a run, and the same shell is right in one hole and wrong in the next. The board says so before anyone speaks: one connected ledge with holes punched in it, not a row of boxes.
payload._trayComment: trayExtraCount is 1 so the last hole of a round can never be filled by elimination. With only the answer left in the tray, a child who puts it in has practised counting the tray rather than reading the reef.
payload._revealedComment: Two whole repeats are always laid out before the first hole, and the engine checks that against the gaps rather than taking the number on trust. One repeat is a guess; two is a pattern a child can actually see.

prompt.en: Coral, shell, coral, shell. Say it to the end.
prompt.ar: مَرْجَان، صَدَفَة، مَرْجَان، صَدَفَة. أَكْمِلْهَا إِلَى النِّهَايَة.

revealLine.en: The water moved. That is the reef breathing in and out.
revealLine.ar: تَحَرَّكَ المَاء. هَذَا هُوَ الشِّعَابُ يَتَنَفَّسُ دُخُولًا وَخُرُوجًا.

prompt.en: This one goes two, then one. Two holes in the middle.
prompt.ar: هَذِهِ اثْنَتَانِ ثُمَّ وَاحِدَة. وَفَتْحَتَانِ فِي المُنْتَصَف.

revealLine.en: Longer this time. The swell pulls twice before it pushes.
revealLine.ar: أَطْوَلُ هَذِهِ المَرَّة. يَسْحَبُ المَوْجُ مَرَّتَيْنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَدْفَع.

prompt.en: Three things now, over and over. This is the beat the gate opens on.
prompt.ar: ثَلَاثَةُ أَشْيَاءَ الآن، مَرَّةً بَعْدَ مَرَّة. عَلَى هَذَا الإِيقَاعِ تَنْفَتِحُ البَوَّابَة.

revealLine.en: The whole ledge ran, beat by beat. The gate swung open.
revealLine.ar: جَرَتِ الحَافَةُ كُلُّهَا، نَبْضَةً بَعْدَ نَبْضَة. وَانْفَتَحَتِ البَوَّابَة.
